description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeavePermissionTrait' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The trait provides a method to check if a leave record is accessible based on user role and permissions, and it enforces that it must be used within an Endpoint context. It leverages other traits and entity classes related to Employee and Leave management.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the given Leave object is accessible by the current user based on role and ownership. Throws LogicException if used outside an Endpoint context, or a forbidden exception if access checks fail.
